series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Before their big group date, Karane endures an agonizingly embarrassing shopping trip searching for the right swimsuit. When Hakari, Karane, Shizuka, and Nano arrive at the indoor water park and unveil their stunning swimsuits, Rentaro is overwhelmed by their beauty, sparking an explosive comedic nosebleed.
Prior events (Part 2): Determined not to favor any girlfriend, Rentaro blindfolds himself, but the girls demand his full, honest admiration. Rentaro passionately praises each girl's unique beauty, but when arrogant pickup artists try to hit on them, Hakari and Nano boldly kiss Rentaro in public to claim their man.
Prior events (Part 3): When the water park's artificial wave machine roars to life, playful waves quickly turn into a raging surge. Shizuka loses hold of her float ring and gets swept into the churning deep end, prompting Rentaro to leap straight into the treacherous current to save her life.
Prior events (Part 4): Rentaro dives through the turbulent swells and rescues Shizuka, carrying her safely to the deck. Watching Rentaro risk his life, Nano questions her own cold, detached logic of efficiency, only for Rentaro to warmly teach her that in the Rentaro Family, love is never divided, but infinitely shared.
Prior events (Part 5): While the others continue swimming, Karane sits alone on a poolside bench wrapped tightly in a towel, shivering from a mysterious chill. Comparing her flat chest and prickly personality to Hakari and Nano, she drowns in painful self-doubt until Rentaro gently sits down right beside her.
